query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN googleMapsUrl IS NOT NULL AND googleMapsUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hasUrl,
  SUM(CASE WHEN googleRating IS NOT NULL AND (googleMapsUrl IS NULL OR googleMapsUrl = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hasRatingNoUrl
FROM businesses WHERE isActive = 1;
